statement: The only implementation file present, src/impl.txt, contains the literal placeholder text 'wrong' instead of a real auth implementation, which is why targetedTests exits 1 while lint/typecheck pass (nothing to lint/typecheck meaningfully). The previously-rejected paths README.md, src/auth, tests/fixtures do not exist in this repo, so any patch must target src/impl.txt (or newly-created files consistent with the actual tree) and be validated against the existing test/golden/*.json fixtures via run-tests.sh.
